data_streams.name: Work Orders: AssetSys -> 4FS
data_streams.description: Work order XML from AssetSys, status-translated (e.g. VOORBEREID -> In Process), written to 4FS serviceOrders; the shared entry gateway assetsysRestService validates and routes incoming AssetSys webhook data to the JMS queue ettm.assetsysFourfsWorkOrder before either consumer picks it up. Two parallel production implementations exist: CAI-group CAI variant (part1) and the non-CAI assetsysFourfs-group variant (part2), both consuming the same queue -- likely distinct context-group/environment deployments rather than a true duplicate; treat with medium confidence on which is authoritative for a given company context. In the part2 chain, the job AliTST is wired into the real flow but sets placeholder-looking globalMap values (e.g. 'ExchangeTST'), which may indicate leftover test scaffolding never removed from production. (mechanism: REST webhook relay + JMS (ettm.assetsysFourfsWorkOrder) + REST (4FS serviceOrders))
